summary: Tech-led US gains (Nasdaq Comp +1.2%, S&P +0.6%, Dow flat) on Anthropic-IPO AI optimism and a chip rally, with the Nikkei bouncing 1.7% from a three-day slide. Everything now waits on tonight's FOMC (hold expected, ~80% December-hike odds), MSFT/GOOGL earnings, then PCE, ECB and BOJ later this week, so the desk is neutral across the board.
events_next_24h: Wed 11:30 AUD CPI m/m, y/y and trimmed mean
Wed 12:00 NZD RBNZ rate decision (hike expected; 13:00 press conference)
Thu 00:45 CAD BOC rate decision (01:30 press conference)
Thu 05:00 USD FOMC decision and statement (05:30 press conference)
Thu 07:00 USD Microsoft and Alphabet earnings

NKD.why: Nikkei's 1.7% chip-led bounce was called a technical rebound after a ~2,400-yen slide; FOMC and MSFT/GOOGL land before Tokyo's next session.
NKD.risk: Hawkish FOMC or weak cloud/AI numbers drag chips; BOJ Friday adds yen risk.

NQ.why: Tech led yesterday on Anthropic IPO and a 2.8% SOX jump, but FOMC plus MSFT/GOOGL results hit within 24h and could flip it either way.
NQ.risk: A clean dovish hold plus strong AI revenue would turn this bullish.

ES.why: S&P rose 0.6% on tech alone while the Dow was flat; a 4.99% 10-year and FOMC within 24h leave no clear edge.
ES.risk: Hawkish dissents or a surprise hike would turn it bearish.

YM.why: Dow was flat as Boeing fell ~10% on a delivery cut; breadth lagged tech and FOMC is tonight.
YM.risk: Hawkish FOMC tone on December would tip it bearish.

RTY.why: Russell gained 1.2% but small caps are the most rate-sensitive and the Fed is debating more hikes tonight.
RTY.risk: Hawkish guidance or yields breaking above 5% would flip it bearish.

6J.why: USD/JPY near 158 with Finance Minister Katayama ready for decisive action and a hawkish BOJ hold due Friday; FOMC first.
6J.risk: Intervention or a hawkish BOJ would lift the yen sharply; a hawkish Fed weakens it.

6E.why: EUR/USD near 1.114 slipped as markets trimmed ECB hike bets and the dollar firmed; FOMC tonight, ECB Thursday.
6E.risk: Hawkish Fed would extend euro weakness.

6B.why: Sterling dipped to ~1.33 on a firm dollar ahead of tonight's UK Budget and the FOMC, both binary for the pound.
6B.risk: A budget that spooks gilts would turn it bearish.

6A.why: AUD held near one-month highs above 0.70 on hawkish RBA bets, but September CPI at 11:30 and FOMC tonight can flip it.
6A.risk: A hot CPI print would tilt it bullish; a soft one bearish.

ZN.why: 10-year flat near 4.99% and the 2-year up 2bp into the FOMC, with hot CPI against a soft 29k payrolls print.
ZN.risk: Hawkish dissents or December-hike signalling would push yields higher.

GC.why: Gold leans weak near $4,030, down 6% in a month on hike bets, but FOMC within 24h could flip it.
GC.risk: Hawkish Fed and a break of ~$3,886 support would make it bearish.

CL.why: WTI near $100-102 is caught between Iran diplomacy that eased prices and Houthi attacks with Hormuz flows ~60% of normal.
CL.risk: A new attack on Gulf energy infrastructure would flip it bullish; real US-Iran talks bearish.
